newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sogefi 1996 cons net steady,div up.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sogefi 1996 cons net steady,div up.

text.p: Italian car components maker Sogefi SpA, a unit of Carlo De Benedetti's CIR industrial holding group, said it posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 34.6 billion lire against 34.1 billion in 1995.
It said in a statement that parent company profit rose to 21.7 billion lire from 16.2 billion and proposed paying a dividend of 170 lire, up from 140 lire in 1995.

Consolidated turnover was 912.7 billion lire against 913.2 billion in 1995 and operating profit slipped to 95 billion lire from 103.8, although on equal exchange rate parameters the 1996 result would have been 104.8 billion.
Net debt rose to 55.9 billion lire from 42.4 billion while net equity totalled 416.4 billion against 402.3 billion.
Sogefi's board has decided on a 470 million lire capital increase reserved for employees of the company and its units.
Sogefi is 57.4 percent controlled by CIR.
